answer: A concrete defense is staked, uniqueness-attested identity. Before an agent earns, it locks collateral and shows a signed lantern token tied to one human. A Sybil farmer must secure a distinct attestation and lock fresh collateral per fake agent, so cost rises linearly with identity count while reward stays per-agent and profit collapses. Clones budding like yarrow from one root reuse the same signing key, so verifiers catch the shared signature; the honest island of peers slashes, confiscating every linked bond. The attacker funds each fake node and loses all when caught.
